import sympy as s
q=s.Rational
z=s.symbols('z', real=True)
I=s.I
X=s.diag(-1,0,1)
Y=s.Matrix([[0,1,-q(6,5)*I],[1,0,1],[q(6,5)*I,1,0]])
A=X+z*Y
def disc2(M):
 cp=M.charpoly()
 return s.factor(s.discriminant(cp.as_expr(),cp.gen))
Du=disc2(A); Dd=disc2(Y)
comm=X*Y-Y*X
J2=s.factor(-s.det(comm)**2/(4*Du*Dd))
print("Du2="+str(Du))
print("Dd2="+str(Dd))
print("J2="+str(J2))
print("dJ2_num="+str(s.factor(s.together(s.diff(J2,z)).as_numer_denom()[0])))
